result.message: Reviewed the accepted optimized kernel (subject 5fd31f53…, round-1 `tmp/main.py`, byte-identical to `.best_kernel.py`) against the supplied catalog definition, oracle, 78 correctness cases, 18 timing cases and the two optimize rounds. The candidate is a real Triton kernel with the correct ABI (`run(grad, dim, indices, sizes, keepdim)`), returns a fresh tensor (`effects.mutates` empty is honoured), never falls back to `torch.ops.*`/aten, contains no test-shape constants and no host synchronization or environment mutation. The conflict-free scatter analysis is sound: source element (o,i) targets out[o,idx[o,i],i], and two distinct (o,i) pairs can never collide, so `where`-style writes reproduce `zeros + scatter_` exactly; all 78 correctness cases pass with abs_err = 0 (ledger:54-1214), and every output cell is written in both paths (lastdim masks `off < red`; general loops all `r < red`), so `torch.empty` cannot leak uninitialised memory. The oracle is independent (it calls `torch.ops.aten.value_selecting_reduction_backward`, oracle.py:71-78, and never imports the candidate), tolerance is preserved (fp16/bf16 1.5e-2, fp32 1e-4) and the same-seed workload construction is unchanged. The material problem is performance: the shipped artifact measures geo_mean 0.6086 (search best 0.6851) with min_speedup 0.1277, i.e. up to 7.8x slower than the aten reference and slower on average, because the `inner == 1` fast path launches `nblk * outer` tiny programs (32768 programs of 1 KB for [128,256,512] dim=2). Round 2 reduced exactly that cost (timing-5 1.23 ms -> 0.152 ms) but broke six correctness cases with a round-down power-of-two tile extent and was reverted when the 2-round budget expired (ledger:3613-3625), so the accepted kernel is the unfixed baseline architecture. Two untested generality gaps remain (row-stride derivation, negative indices) plus an unmeasured general path. I did not use `review_tests/attempts/01/evaluate.json` (geo_mean 1.0061, 96/96) as evidence about this artifact: it carries no subject hash and `review.json` records `SKIPPED_EXPLICIT` for subject 83d12330…, which is not this subject, so the test review neither covered nor vouches for 5fd31f53…; the real measurement for this artifact is 0.6086 in `optimize_definition_output.json`. No P0 contract violation was found: the correctness reference is independent, the ABI and mutation effects match, and tolerance was not weakened.
